# Stelline

> Stelline is a calm Star Battle-style logic puzzle game for iPhone (iOS 26 or later). Every board is generated on the device and verified to have exactly one solution, then graded Easy to Expert by the same seventeen-technique deduction engine that powers its hints. Paid once (USD 1.99), no ads, no account, no data collected. Version 1.1 adds Today's board, the same board for everyone for one UTC day, with optional Game Center leaderboards and shareable board links.

Stelline (Italian for "little stars") is made by one independent developer and written from scratch in Swift, including its own generator, solver and deduction engine. This file follows the llms.txt convention and summarises the site at https://stelline.page for answer engines and assistants. Last updated 11 September 2026.

- [Home page](https://stelline.page/): overview and screenshots.

## App

- [Stelline on the App Store](https://apps.apple.com/app/id6808032290): USD 1.99, paid once, no in-app purchases, no subscription.
- Platform: iPhone only (not iPad, Mac or Apple Watch), iOS 26 or later, portrait orientation, English. Category: Games, Puzzle. Age rating 4+.
- Board links: https://stelline.page/b/<code> opens a shared board in Stelline when the app is installed; otherwise the page shows the board's id, size, mode and region map with a link to the App Store.

## Facts

- Stelline is a Star Battle-style logic puzzle: place queens (or stars) so that every row, every column and every colour region holds exactly the required number, and no two pieces touch, not even diagonally.
- Two modes: 1 queen (one queen per row, column and region) on 6×6 to 11×11 boards, and 2 stars (two stars per row, column and region) on 9×9 to 11×11 boards. Four built-in sample boards are included.
- Every board has exactly one solution. Boards are generated on the iPhone, so there is no pack to run out of and nothing to download, and an exact solver checks each one before it is shown.
- Four difficulty tiers, Easy, Medium, Hard and Expert, graded by a deduction engine with seventeen techniques that solves each board the way a person would. The grade does not depend on the board size. Easy, Medium and Hard 1 queen boards and Medium 2 stars boards need direct deductions only; Expert 1 queen boards need one-level what-if reasoning; Expert 2 stars boards (10×10 and up) are verified unique and may need more.
- Hints are unlimited, with no cooldown, and work in stages: two counters (misplaced queens, misplaced dots) that never say where; then "Show me where", which highlights the row, column or region behind the next logical step, then the exact cells, names the technique and applies it on request; a mistake on the board is narrowed down to the region, then the cells, and cleared on request. "Reveal" places one solution piece only when no logical step exists. A solve with no hints and no conflicts earns the Flawless badge.
- Controls: tap a cell to cycle empty, dot, queen or star; drag across cells to dot them (start on a dot to erase). A placed piece dots its eight neighbours automatically; completed rows, columns and regions can dot themselves too. Auto-check stripes pieces that touch or exceed a row, column or region. Undo, redo and clear, with the history saved alongside the game. A timer that can be hidden. No lives, no streaks.
- The game saves itself after every move; the Home screen shows Continue with the board size and time so far.
- Fully offline: no internet connection is needed, ever, and nothing is downloaded after installation.
- No data collected: no account, no ads, no analytics, no third-party code and no network code beyond the optional Game Center leaderboards. The App Store privacy label is "Data Not Collected". Settings and saved games stay on the iPhone and are deleted with the app.
- Appearance: an original pastel palette with a named colour for every region, a Classic black-and-white theme with heavy region borders, a Colour-blind mode with high-contrast colours and thicker borders, and light, dark or system appearance. Crown or star pieces, dot or X marks.
- Accessibility: full VoiceOver support (every cell announces its state, region colour, row and column, with actions to mark, place and clear), Dynamic Type, Reduce Motion, and haptics that can be turned off.
- Today's board (version 1.1): the same board for every player for 24 hours, a 9×9 board in 1 queen mode and a 10×10 board in 2 stars mode, generated on the iPhone from the UTC date, so no connection is needed. The day changes at midnight UTC. Marks, undo history and time are kept per day and mode.
- Game Center leaderboards (version 1.1): optional and off by default. When turned on in Settings, the app posts the time on Today's board to the day's leaderboard for that mode (lower is better, reset daily). Everything else works without it, entirely offline.
- Board links (version 1.1): every board has an id and a shareable link of the form https://stelline.page/b/<code>; a friend opens it with one tap when Stelline is installed, or types the code under Sample boards.
- Version 1.1 also brings a redesigned Home screen and asks for confirmation before Clear or New puzzle wipes a game in progress.
- Star Battle is a puzzle genre name. Apple, iPhone, App Store and Game Center are trademarks of Apple Inc.
